summary: At the end of a scan track the executor publishes zero body velocity while the capture-close service call is in flight. When that handshake spans more than one control tick the swerve controller latches Brake, and the vehicle must come to a full stop from 10 km/h before it can drive again. The pass then replans a fresh rest-to-rest profile for the remaining distance, so the vehicle brakes early, stops, drives a short distance and stops again.
found_by: operator observation of the GUI during the v2 full-area run, then traced in the execution archive
mechanism: execution_node.py:316 requests capture off once the camera has passed the region plus the overrun distance
execution_node.py:295 returns early with a zero command while capture.future is pending and the target is off, so core.update() is not called and the tracker freezes in ALIGNING
swerve.hpp:143 takes Drive to Brake when the allocated wheel speeds are zero, with reason STOP_REQUEST
swerve.hpp:157 releases Brake only once the wheels have actually stopped, which from 2.78 m/s costs about 2.8 s and 3.9 m
tracking.py:210 then rebuilds the profile from the remaining distance, producing the second acceleration and the second stop
already_known_for_the_other_direction: The comment at execution_node.py:292 reads 'An open now happens while a pass is already driving its lead-in, and must not brake the vehicle for the duration of a handshake.' The open direction was exempted with the 'not self.capture.target' condition. The close direction was left halting the step.

rate.definition: brake events inside a PASS that are neither the terminal stop, the validator pause probe, nor a fault
rate.note: it is a race on the service round trip, not a property of a particular track

excluded_from_the_count.validator_pause_probe: track 0 of every run shows state PAUSING then PAUSED; that is tools/validate_operator_session.py exercising pause retention on purpose, coasting about 2.2 m
excluded_from_the_count.fault_braking: the track 9 stop in rough100_v2_full_rated_1 at 754.676 s is the scan-motion fault stopping the vehicle

data_impact: None observed. At the braking tick capture_active is already false and the vehicle is past the region in the run-out buffer. The cost is time and an unplanned full-authority brake that the trajectory never budgeted.
not_fixed: No change made. Two directions were identified: extend the existing open-direction exemption to the close, or keep the requirement that a close settles before the next step but move it to the step transition rather than the middle of a PASS.
regression_status: Long standing, not introduced by recent work: present in the 2026-09-14 run used for the section 6 sign-off's sibling runs and in the 2026-09-15 rough-road run.
